# Canonical JavaScript export names

Upstream crate: tree-sitter-javascript 0.25.0 at commit
44c892e0be055ac465d5eeddae6d3e194424e7de. The MIT LICENSE is retained.

The handwritten grammar delta applies the existing unrestricted property-name
reserved-word set to ModuleExportName. Reserved exported names remain legal;
function names and import binding names retain global reserved-word checks.
An export alias does not create an additional declaration.

Regenerate with tree-sitter CLI 0.25.10, ABI 15. ABI 14 drops the reserved-word
sets and incorrectly admits reserved binding names, so it is not supported for
this grammar. The Rust producer and Python oracle share these generated bytes.
Python requires tree-sitter 0.25.2 or newer; the project lock pins 0.25.2.
Grammar fingerprints bind all vendor files and invalidate old preflight policy
commitments. No captured source or historical label is rewritten.
